title: Look nice, but a little rough…
text:
Look nice, but a little rough…. [[VIDEOID:161a6a030ffea58e41deda564ce19118]] This looks best in the dark. With the lights on you see a lot of the little imperfections. This kinda has a rough look to it, not sure if it is intentional. I didn’t see anything mentioned in the description of it. The resin material does look like a white plaster. I did discover the center piece does have a battery in it. You just need to pull the tab out. The lights on the House and music work off the AC adapter.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
